page.notes: Leading fragment "x" at the start of the first line is uncertain; marked [?]. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout. Printed "vrgenta", "vt", "vbi", "inuestigans", "declarauit", "alijs" and "inuehi" were normalised to u/v and i/j usage as instructed. Italic passages are "Sedes aliæ errare possunt, & errant." and "&c. Sola Romana est, quæ nec sibi unquam fucum fecit, nec aliis. &c.". The paragraph break before "Non potuit" is inferred from the short line end above it.
